doctrine: Regulation dates are corrected data, never static copy. A wrong date here becomes a published correction (see /api/corrections), never a hidden edit — the feed is defensible precisely because a wrong date destroys a careless competitor faster than it destroys us. Dates are CELEX-keyed where applicable and re-verified quarterly.
note: The regulatory calendar as a machine-readable feed: demand-creating deadlines that force companies to need measured evidence. Each entry: what / when / why it matters / status.

regulations.title: EU AI Act — Article 50 transparency duties
regulations.what: Interactive disclosure, generative marking, emotion/biometric info, deepfake/public-interest text disclosure.
regulations.why_it_matters: The marking duties are live; measurement of marking survival is the 2 Dec demo's anchor.

regulations.title: EU AI Act — Article 50(2) marking grace for pre-existing systems
regulations.what: Grace ends for provider-side marking of GenAI systems already on the market; deployer duties had no deferral.
regulations.why_it_matters: The dated cliff — the 2 Dec retrofit demo and the '0 of 108 markings survive' measurement.

regulations.title: EU AI Act — high-risk Annex III deferral
regulations.instrument: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 Annex III via Digital Omnibus Reg (EU) 2026/1744
regulations.what: High-risk Annex III obligations deferred to 2 Dec 2027 (not 2 Aug 2026); Annex I to 2 Aug 2028.
regulations.why_it_matters: The corrected date — serving 2 Aug 2026 would be a credibility wound; this entry is itself a published correction (CORR-007).

regulations.title: Illinois SB 315 — annual independent third-party audits of frontier AI
regulations.what: First US state mandating annual independent third-party audits of frontier AI; IL+NY+CA ≈ 40% of US market.
regulations.why_it_matters: The LOI target: the law forces companies to need exactly what we sell — a signed, independent, third-party measurement.

regulations.title: Colorado SB 26-189 — ADMT transparency
regulations.what: Developer technical docs to deployers, 3-yr compliance records, point-of-interaction notice, 30-day explanation after adverse outcomes, human review. AG sole enforcer, 60-day cure.
regulations.why_it_matters: Comment window closed 5 Oct / hearing 26 Oct 2026; the ADMT transparency evidence standard is our framing.

regulations.title: New York RAISE — AI accountability
regulations.what: NY AI accountability requirements (with CO/IL — the ~40% US market block).
regulations.why_it_matters: Third leg of the demand-creating block; audit-evidence products apply.

regulations.title: California SB 53 — AI safety frontier model framework
regulations.what: CA frontier AI framework; adds to the IL+NY+CA market block.
regulations.why_it_matters: The ramp's LOI target list — laws that force companies to need measured evidence.

regulations.title: EU Cyber Resilience Act — Article 14 reporting
regulations.what: CRA obligations incl. Art 14 (vulnerability reporting) on the schedule; part of the 417-provision corpus.
regulations.why_it_matters: The ramp's demand-creating deadline list: CRA reporting forces SBOM/vulnerability evidence.

regulations.title: EU AI Act — Measure 3.4 detector interoperability
regulations.why_it_matters: The detector-interop deadline — provenance measurement surface.

regulations.title: FCA stablecoin regime (x402 posture)
regulations.what: UK stablecoin regulatory regime commences; x402 agent-paid data products posture (agents-only, humans never charged).
regulations.why_it_matters: The x402 rail timing — verification stays free forever.

regulations.title: GPAI Code of Practice — Measure 3.5 positioning
regulations.instrument: EU AI Act Art 55 + GPAI CoP
regulations.what: No registry exists for external evaluators under Measure 3.5; path = publish AEF-1 conformance + evidence record + contact AI Office/signatories.
regulations.why_it_matters: The empty-chair: the external-evaluator record positioning is ours to shape.

regulations.title: AI Growth Lab (Legal Services) — application window
regulations.what: Free coordinated access to SRA/ICO/LSB/CLC/MoJ/BIST; advisory only, no funding. Closes 11:59pm 27 Sep.
regulations.why_it_matters: The single first application to file — measurement infrastructure for legal-AI compliance.
